headline: 海洋奇缘领跑，掌舵少女剧集热
headlineEn: Moana leads; Steering Girl heats up TV
summary: 今日仅1部电影上映，本周新增5部；《海洋奇缘：启航》领跑电影热度，《掌舵少女》位居剧集榜首，末日地堡、侠探杰克等持续在榜，生化危机：爆发夜待映。
summaryEn: One movie opens today and five this week; Moana: Set Sail leads film buzz while Steering Girl tops TV, with Silo and Reacher still trending; Resident Evil: Outbreak Night is upcoming.

industryHighlights.text: 今日1部电影上映，本周共5部新片。
industryHighlights.en: One movie opens today, with five new films this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《海洋奇缘：启航》领跑电影热度，《掌舵少女》居剧集榜首。
industryHighlights.en: Moana: Set Sail leads film buzz; Girl at the Helm tops TV.

industryHighlights.text: 《最后目击》《侠探杰克》持续在剧集榜，《末日地堡》周榜热度高。
industryHighlights.en: The Last Witness and Reacher stay on TV charts; Silo is hot weekly.

industryHighlights.text: 新片《生化危机：爆发夜》即将上映。
industryHighlights.en: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night is set to release soon.
